title: Dream Feed by The Hawtplates at the HERE Arts Center #dreamfeed #theh...
transcript: If you loved oratorio for living things as much as I did, may I present to you dreamfeed by the Hot plates. This is another concept forward musical piece staged in the round with a centerpiece of massive chimes. Stylistically, the music spans across an acoustic psychedelic electro spectrum with live instrumentation, atmospheric percussion and effects, and an abundance of stunning three part harmonies. Thematically, it centers on dreams. Some of the music is about specific dreams, others seem to be more about the dreaming state. And in some ways, the piece itself is a dream sequence. I think I spent the early parts of the show trying to over interpret it, but this honestly became really difficult because 1. I don't think, in retrospect, that it's something that's meant to be easily pinned down, and 2 it just became too mesmerizing to intellectualize in the moment. I actually came out of the experience so incredibly relaxed, which was a pleasant surprise. Dream feed is running at the Here Arts Center through the 25th.
